summary: Tested the Patient App / Provider App separation against the live shared Supabase. New file test_patient_app_parity.py: 13 of 13 pass after one fix by the testing agent. Before the fix, provider suspend returned 500. Results: /api/admin/patients returns exactly the 10 Patient App users with correct names and phones, and Manish's id is 54acfc31. Patient suspend/unsuspend on Test Patient Lko works, and the users row and provider rows are unchanged. Patient archive/restore on Test City Capture works: the row leaves the list, shows in deleted?app=patient with days_left 29-30 and reason 'admin_deleted: parity test', and comes back as Lucknow. The provider list and the provider deleted count did not change. The master admin is skipped (updated 0). Overlap test on Manish: provider suspend sets his diagnostic_centre and path_lab profiles to 'suspended', while he stays not suspended as a patient and his users row is unchanged (checked in the DB mid-test). Provider unsuspend brings back 'pending' and 'pending_review'. Patient suspend does not touch his provider rows. Provider archive/restore on Xenon (9999900003) works, and users.is_archived stays false. A users/customer_profiles/DC snapshot taken before and after the whole run is identical. UI checked: the 10 rows show and no row says 'Name not added yet'. Select, suspend dialog (app-scoped wording, confirm disabled until a reason is typed), SUSPENDED tag, unsuspend, patients-deleted-toggle (0 deleted patients) and back, and provider-directory-deleted-toggle (159 rows, with type filter) all work. Regression: the Doctor tab still has 5. test_directory_parity role counts fail because the data has drifted (see context).

critical.issue: Returned 500 (CheckViolationError path_lab_profiles_check) for any user with a path_lab or diagnostic_centre profile. The DB requires suspension_reason to be set when verification_status='suspended', and suspend_profiles never set it. FIXED by the testing agent in canonical_providers.py: it now sets suspension_reason when the column exists, clears it on unsuspend, and runs suspend in one transaction.

minor.issue: suspend_profiles only updates cp.TABLES, not paramedic_profiles. users_with_profiles counts paramedic users as 'has profile', so they are not in the staff fallback either. Suspending a paramedic from the console therefore changes nothing, yet the call reports success.

user_admin.py lines 165-166 set users.is_suspended=FALSE for ALL uids, not just staff-only ones. This touches the shared login row and would clear a users-level suspension set elsewhere (Patient App or legacy). Restrict it to `staff` the way suspend does.
Master-admin protection matches only customer_profiles.phone. If that phone is NULL, the master admin's patient profile is not protected. Also match the phone joined from users.phone.

This sends real suspension and unsuspension emails to real providers. Manish Mishra (a real DC owner) got about 3 suspend and 3 unsuspend emails during this test run because the requested overlap test runs on him. Consider a test or dry-run flag, or not emailing on unsuspend of a suspension that was just made.

issues: When a row gets the SUSPENDED tag, the table columns reflow (the Phone column moves about 135px). Use table-layout fixed or set column widths.

critical_code_review_comments: canonical_providers.suspend_profiles had no CheckViolation handling and was not transactional; a failure partway through could leave some tables suspended (now fixed by the testing agent)

directory.profile_rows sets is_suspended = users.is_suspended OR kyc=='suspended', so a legacy users-level suspension still shows the provider as suspended. This is fine, but unsuspend app:provider clears it as a side effect
Provider unsuspend leaves local_decision as '{}' instead of NULL (cosmetic)

success_rate.backend: 100% (13/13 new parity tests after fix; 1 stale role-count expectation in test_directory_parity)

seed_data_creation: None. Every suspend and archive was reversed, and the before/after DB snapshot of the users, customer_profiles and DC rows is identical. Mongo contacts for Manish already existed or were created by contacts_for_users.

rca of the issue: Provider suspend 500: path_lab_profiles and diagnostic_centre_profiles both have CHECK (verification_status <> 'suspended' OR suspension_reason IS NOT NULL). suspend_profiles only wrote local_decision and verification_status. Reproduce with POST /admin/users/bulk {user_ids:['54acfc31-...'], action:'suspend', app:'provider', reason:'parity test'}, which returned 500. Mitigation applied: write suspension_reason when the column exists and clear it on unsuspend.
